# Model specification: fram 1.0.0

SPI F-RAM used for parameters (FM25V02 / fm25xxx). Content persists in the host file named in the configuration.

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | Read, write with write enable, status, ID, persistence. |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| write_enable | control | base | WREN: allows the next write; WRDI clears it. |
| status | status | base | Status register (WEL, block protection: stored). |
| read | data | base | READ at a 2-byte address, continuing sequentially. |
| write | data | base | WRITE at a 2-byte address, continuing sequentially. |
| device_id | status | base | RDID response bytes as the datasheet states. |
| size | status | base | Memory size from the Devicetree (size). |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-FRAM-B001 | base | A WRITE after WREN stores bytes at sequential addresses wrapping at size; without WREN it stores nothing; chip deselect ends the command and clears the write-enable latch after a write. |
| ADV-FRAM-B002 | base | A READ returns the stored bytes at sequential addresses, wrapping at size; unwritten bytes read as the host file's content (0xFF/0x00 as initialised). |
| ADV-FRAM-B003 | base | RDID returns the datasheet device ID bytes; RDSR returns the status with WEL reflecting write_enable. |
| ADV-FRAM-B004 | base | Written content is in the host file when the run ends and is read back on the next run. |

**Timing.** Writes take effect immediately (F-RAM has no write delay).

**Out of scope.** sleep mode, block protection enforcement (stored only), fast read
